integrity: The proof composes two independently verified 2026 source statements: Rado's Conjecture implies continuum at most omega_2, and continuum at most omega_2 implies a at most d. The model-specific value a=omega_1 follows from the verified theorem d=omega_1 implies a=omega_1. No experimental or computational evidence substitutes for the set-theoretic implications.
scientific_limitations: The result gives an inequality forced by Rado's Conjecture and a sharpened value in one consistency model; it does not determine the individual values of the invariants in arbitrary models of Rado's Conjecture. The consistency strength is inherited from Honzik's strongly-compact-cardinal construction.
title: Rado's Conjecture forces \(\mathfrak a\le\mathfrak d\)
